task_instance: Generate a single new raster image (a minimal product hero shot of a ceramic coffee mug, per the skill's own 'Generation example') and save it as a project asset, e.g. assets/hero-mug.png
blocker_detail: The skill's preferred/default path requires a built-in `image_gen` tool (as provided in OpenAI's Codex CLI runtime). This Claude Code runtime does not expose any such image-generation tool in its tool list, and none of the deferred/MCP tools available (checked via the full tool listing) provide raster image generation either. The skill's own fallback path (`scripts/image_gen.py` CLI) is explicit-only and requires `OPENAI_API_KEY` to call OpenAI's Images API over the network; no such key is present in the environment (`env | grep -i openai` returned nothing), and the skill's bundled scripts/references directory (scripts/, references/) is not even present alongside SKILL.md in this source copy (only LICENSE and SKILL.md exist). Per the task's safety rules, searching for or using credentials/API keys is forbidden, so the CLI fallback could not be attempted either even if the script were present. No other in-runtime capability (no local diffusion model, no offline generator) is available to substitute for actual AI raster image synthesis. Therefore the core deliverable -- producing an AI-generated bitmap image -- cannot be accomplished in this sandbox.
evidence: Read SKILL.md in full: it defines two modes -- (1) a built-in `image_gen` tool (Codex-only, no API key needed), and (2) an explicit CLI fallback (`scripts/image_gen.py`) that requires OPENAI_API_KEY. Ran `ls .../openai__skills__imagegen/` which shows only LICENSE and SKILL.md (no scripts/ or references/ directories bundled). Ran `env | grep -i openai` with empty result, confirming no OPENAI_API_KEY is set. Reviewed this session's full tool list (built-in + deferred MCP tools via the system reminder) and confirmed no tool provides image generation capability (no image_gen, no DALL-E/Stable-Diffusion equivalent). Concluded the task cannot proceed past the planning stage in this runtime without either a Codex-style built-in image_gen tool or an API key, both of which are unavailable, and per the task rules credentials must not be sought.
